card.title: KV-1 1939
card.flavorText: The KV-1 was a Soviet Kliment Voroshilov (KV) heavy tank variant used by the Red Army during WWII. The KV series were known for their heavy armor and were almost immune to the guns of the early Panzer III and Panzer IV tanks that were used by the Axis at the start of the war. The KV-1 had a crew of 5 and a main armament of a 76.2 mm M1941 ZiS-5 gun and a secondary armament of 3x to 4x DT machine guns. It was produced from 1939 to 1945 and 5,219 units were built.
